notes.title: Happy Halloween! A New Hat-Tabulous Update has been posted!!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26177583/f05bb7aa877485cb9c9d4c96735a85433cdbd9d9.png[/img]

To celebrate that we're on Sale we decided to add a ton of new hats to the game. There are now over 1100 hats to unlock, in addition to some other changes and a new slice hunt game mode modifier!

[list]
    [*]Added a ton of new hats for your slothy heads and that undeniable fun of unlocking them!
    [*]New Game Mode Option, turn on/off Slice Denied to disallow scoring of your own team's slices for a Slice Hunt variation of classic game mode, Kill Confirmed!
    [*]Fix to public lobbys to not have private controls in some instances
    [*]Made it so that going into match settings does not reset game mode
    [*]Various other bug fixes
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/459350/Battlesloths_2025_The_Great_Pizza_Wars/


Get the game now while it's still on sale! Oh... and remember... Stay Slothy!

notes.title: Community Stream - Pizza Party Sale-ebration
notes.content:
Greetings Sloth Slayers, 

Come join our live stream and play BS2025 with members of Rooster Teeth! Today we're live at 5pm (central time) on Twitch at [url=https://go.twitch.tv/roosterteeth]  Twitch.tv/roosterteeth [/url] with special guests Gus Sorola, Andy Blanchard, Matt Bragg, and Chad James from ScrewAttack. 

Starting at 5pm, hit that ol' "Online" button from the glorious Battlesloths Main Menu for a chance to play LIVE with us...and win prizes?! Yeah I said prizes! Beat the Rooster Teeth crew to be entered for a chance to win a brand spankin' new, pixel annihilating Nvidia GTX 1060 graphics card!

See you online!

notes.title: Big Update! New Levels! Mayan Mutant Sewers of Slouth America! Moar Hats!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26177583/6b3edacea274fb1939843c0d1b549d90af625b3d.gif[/img]

It's here! The Sloths are venturing deep down into the dank sewers of Central Slouth America... There are three new levels within the new location and tons of new hats to fight over and unlock! More fun to come. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/459350/Battlesloths_2025_The_Great_Pizza_Wars/

Complete breakdown of the update below!

Are you ready for the Changelist??

[list]
    [*] 3 new levels in a brand new biome, Mayan Sewers!
    [*] Adding a bunch of new hats to unlock! Including the Acheivement Hunter Mr. Diddles! He has two watches and he's ashamed of being a diddler, but he's also a champion at it.
    [*] The Mutant Sewers feature a brand new hazard, rushing water that can push and destroy sloths and slices.
    [*] Fixes timed game modes not finishing.
    [*] Sprucing up the Hat Unlock animation with a few SFX to randomize between
    [*] Bots can only equip normal hats now. No more Golden Hats for you dirty theiving AI bots! 
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26177583/3e39e38f89ca2d937fdc0a0798738fa472497914.gif[/img]

notes.title: Single Player Challenge Mode Added!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26177583/974bcee13c70dc7c1b3c0a949bdcdd8e082d2cfb.png[/img]

To celebrate the kick-off of RTX Austin, the Slo-Bots are back in town and they have 30 brand new challenges just for you, with tons of opportunities to earn more hats! 

We've been hard at work preparing for our FREE 'Pizza Party' weekend that runs through July 9th! Try the game, wage war on the Slo-Bots, eat all the pizza and unlock some hats!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26177583/8873c88c8255717ab5aa69ce85278f1936c08c73.gif[/img]

We've also made a bunch of improvements, additions and fixes to the game...

Changelist below!

[list]
 [*] Adding 30 Player Challenges, new ui and achievements!
 [*] Fixing jawbreaker hazard in Cake World, with slices rendering and networking issues
 [*] Reclaim slice match option added, slices matching your team will be reclaimed by player instead of picked up to return to base
 [*] Tuned laser rifle.  turn speed doubled.  turn on cost lowered from .25 to .1
 [*] Localization udate to support challenges and other features.  
 [*] Credits fixed.  
 [*] Spacing out sloth intro better so names show correctly.  
 [*] Adding a few more loading screen tips...
 [*] Pizza goal shows target goals as "x/targetPoints"
 [*] Setting default button state for game mode.  
 [*] Fixing hats in dance animatinos.  
 [*] Dress up for the level hazard information area. 
[/list]

Spread the word and invite your friends to play online with you! This FREE weekend won't last forever.

ːGoldSliceː  ːTeamToastAssHatː  ːPizzaSlothː  ːTeamToastAssHatː  ːGoldSliceː

notes.title: Battlesloths 2025 is now available in 12 languages!
notes.content:
WHOA! Sloths inherit the earth in 2025, and the whole world needs to prepare for the Slothpacalypse! To help, we've translated the game into 12 different languages.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26177583/0cedee784775bb7b7caed81bef7452a604f57d73.gif[/img]

Language List follows...

[list]
    [*]English
    [*]French
    [*]Italian
    [*]German
    [*]Spanish
    [*]Brazillian Portuguese
    [*]Russian
    [*]Polish
    [*]Japanese
    [*]Korean
    [*]Simplified Chinese
    [*]Traditional Chinese
[/list]

We did human languages before we translate to Sloth (Slothkind already knows what's coming). In the trees, they watch, they wait... Till it's their time down here. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26177583/7b3bc59251644caae11547957b6e620bf2ca0d05.gif[/img]

Enjoy!

- Invisible Collective & Rooster Teeth Games

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Battlesloths 2025: The Great Pizza Wars
notes.content:
Battlesloths 2025: The Great Pizza Wars is Now Available on Steam!

Sloths. Pizza. Chaos.



Battlesloths 2025: The Great Pizza Wars is the fast-paced multiplayer competitive twin-stick shooter of your slothy dreams and the follow-up to the original Battlesloths. Compete with up to 4 human players or play against AI sloths. Use a myriad of weaponry to destroy your enemies in a quest to... EAT. ALL. PIZZA!!!

notes.title: Battlesloths 2025: The Great Pizza Wars has LAUNCHED!!!
notes.content:
Hello all you fun-loving Sloths!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26177583/669c256a2e4de39999e8b40cd7015472059e28c7.gif[/img]

The teams at Rooster Teeth Games and Invisible Collective are happy to announce that Battlesloths 2025: The Great Pizza Wars has launched on Steam! Get it now and start taking out sloths for that sweet delicious doughy pizza, those crazy hats, collecting Trading Cards and unlocking over 50 achievements. 

It's GO Time!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26177583/285a1a9262ddea668538b5ffb7ce2c0e019c0001.gif[/img]


Get three friends together and revel in the silliness of this sloth-pocalypse, shoot-everything-that-moves and get a 'pizza' of the action! We're all proud of what we accomplished and can't wait to play with everyone else. The game will be getting content updates regularly, new hats, levels, features, game modes and more! We hope you enjoy the game and we'll see you online! 

Watch your backs... and don't forget... When you win, dance your ass off!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26177583/81dc2ff9507cf98768bf422ddb2d3260213be21c.gif[/img] [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26177583/237be90ab920e6d4a0b45b626b4a3334ab7e1d64.gif[/img]
